manifest.title: Zero velocity at the top is not zero acceleration
manifest.summary: A tossed ball rises and falls while a second ball is held by a gate at the top height and released at the apex instant. Velocity and acceleration arrows and readouts show velocity passing through zero while acceleration stays -9.8 m/s^2.
assumptions: Constant downward acceleration of 9.8 m/s^2, no air resistance, up is positive.
manifest.description: Two balls share one height scale with up positive. The tossed ball rises from a launch mark to a dashed top line and falls back; the held ball rests on a gate at the top height until the apex instant, then the gate opens and it falls alongside. A velocity arrow on each ball shrinks to a dot at the top, and a downward acceleration arrow stays the same length on every ball in free flight. Text on the right lists height, velocity and acceleration.

composition.title: Zero velocity at the top is not zero acceleration
composition.cardDescription: Toss a ball up at 3.0 to 5.0 m/s. At its top the velocity is zero, yet the acceleration stays -9.8 m/s^2 at every launch speed. No air resistance.
